definition: Systems or services that observe, forecast, store, process or provide information on climate, weather, natural hazards or associated exposure and vulnerability. Includes environmental monitoring only when its climate or hazard relevance is explicit. Producing an assessment or analytical map is cra; maintaining an information system is this measure. Specific adaptation recommendations are adaptation_applications; hazard alerts are ews. Multiple functions qualify only when separately explicit. Excludes emissions accounting and generic environmental data without a stated climate or hazard connection.
